name: Elizabeth
source:
Elias's real mother. She disappears the day before Elias is cursed by the goddess.

It is said that she lives quietly in some village and has lost her shape.

Elias continues to search for her illusion.

"I would be happy if Elias could live happily every day."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
